premises.text: Online merchants must verify shopper identity and keep personal information safe
premises.evidence_span: They need to know that Emily is who she says she is, and once they've confirmed that she is who she says she is, they need to keep her information safe

premises.text: Patented hash-and-graph comparison lets two parties confirm information matches without exchanging the underlying data
premises.evidence_span: patented software that allows two parties to confirm that the information that they have is the same without ever exchanging the information

premises.text: Verified identity attributes from holders can be converted to Siddiqui format and shared via an identity exchange
premises.evidence_span: convert that information into the SIDICI format, make it available on servers, so that we can then access it through an identity exchange

premises.text: Identity verification demand spans banks, payment companies, sharing-economy platforms, and age checks
premises.evidence_span: Banks need it to do KYC. Payment companies need to do it to make sure that they get paid and not ripped off

premises.text: Transactional fees charge per verification and rebate 30% to the information provider
premises.evidence_span: Every verification we do, we charge a fee for. But the interesting thing is we give 30% of that back to the provider of the information

premises.text: BT partnership builds a UK identity exchange as distribution foothold
premises.evidence_span: BT, British Telecom, the largest telco in the world, has selected us to start building the identity exchange for the UK

value.text: Businesses can prove identity and keep information safe without exchanging personal data
value.evidence_span: We help businesses prove that you are who you say you are and keep your information safe

secondary_value.text: Faster, more accurate fraud monitoring and identity verification
secondary_value.evidence_span: We want to bring those two things together and make it fast and accurate

causal_links.evidence_span: take the SIDICI technology and get organizations that hold lots of verified identity attributes
They need to know that Emily is who she says she is
Every verification we do, we charge a fee for

notes: Hash/graph/micro-component cascade folded into one patented verification mechanism. KYC/payments/sharing/age uses treated as one demand set for the same identity product. Price and 30% provider rebate kept as one commercial premise. Anti-template: need, technology/exchange, and commercial modules separately revisable.
